panel-001.alt: Cover artwork for THIS IS MY THING.

captions.text:
How deep could I go
into something I loved?

panel-004.alt: HOGIRL and her fellow graduates talk at a cafe terrace, wearing silver medals.

captions.text:
Leaving school,
everyone began building their careers.

panel-005.alt: Friends discuss their next career steps.

captions.text:
I’m going to work under Cédric—
the chef everyone’s talking about right now!
I’m definitely going to a big company.

panel-006.alt: HOGIRL asks about a specialist chocolate workplace.

captions.text:
Experience mattered
as much as the school name.
It doesn’t have to be famous.

panel-007.alt: HOGIRL walks past food shops on a sunny Paris street.

captions.text:
A place where food lovers
gather in Paris.

panel-008.alt: A small chocolate shop in Paris.

captions.text:
A small chocolate shop,
right in the middle of it all.

panel-009.alt: HOGIRL signs a document beside the chef in a chocolate shop.

panel-010.alt: Wearing a chef jacket, HOGIRL descends the stairs from the shop to the chocolate workshop.

captions.text: I went down the narrow stairs.

panel-011.alt: HOGIRL encounters a hundred chocolate moulds.

captions.text:
Wow… There’s a whole world
of chocolate I never knew.

panel-014.alt: HOGIRL gets up for another day.

captions.text:
And the next morning,
I got up again.

panel-015.alt: HOGIRL keeps learning despite the hard work.

captions.text:
But there was more
I wanted to see.

panel-016.alt: HOGIRL reflects on a tiring workday.

captions.text: Tomorrow, I’ll probably pop right back up.
I think I aged 10 years today.

panel-017.alt: Professional equipment fills the chocolate atelier.

captions.text:
TEMPERING. ENROBING.
AIR REMOVAL.
VACUUM PACKING.
RAPID FREEZING.

Professional equipment
filled the narrow space.

A real world of chocolate
I hadn’t known.

Across the Mediterranean
and the Indian Ocean,
chocolate bound for Japan.

panel-019.alt: HOGIRL sketches new chocolate ideas in a notebook at her worktable.

captions.text:
What if I changed this?
Combined it with that?
Made something that didn’t exist yet?

panel-020.alt: HOGIRL considers what she wants to create.

captions.text:
What do I want
to create?
